label.zh: 技术报告（9 月 15 日开放）

zh.title: SciXXX · 科学加速框架：把真实科学代码库变成可验证的研究环境
zh.summary: SciXXX 将真实科学代码库封装成可运行、可测量、可复现的研究环境。当前开放任务提案，任务形态包括加速、发现、修复、复现与集成。
body: SciXXX 是 DFM 中面向真实科学代码库与研究任务的科学加速框架。
它将真实科学代码库封装成可运行、可测量、可复现的研究环境，包括固定依赖、构建运行环境、定义研究任务，并设置可检查的成功标准。
研究者可以提交自己熟悉的科学代码库，定义希望 AI agent 完成的任务，并说明什么结果可以被视为成功。项目再与领域专家共同完成依赖固定、环境构建和任务评测。当前任务形态包括加速、发现、修复、复现和集成。
SciXXX 的核心价值在于，把真实科学软件、领域判断、任务目标和可验证反馈组织到同一个环境中，为 AI agent、模型训练和科学发现研究提供可运行的基础设施。
SciXXX 当前开放任务提案。项目英文名称待确认【待确认】，详细信息见项目主页。

en.title: SciXXX · Scientific Acceleration Framework: verifiable research environments from real scientific code
en.summary: SciXXX packages real scientific codebases into runnable, measurable and reproducible research environments. Task proposals are open now; task forms include acceleration, discovery, repair, reproduction and integration.
body: SciXXX is the scientific acceleration framework within DFM for real scientific codebases and research tasks.

It packages a real scientific codebase into a runnable, measurable and reproducible research environment: dependencies pinned, the environment built, the research task defined, and success criteria that can be checked.

Researchers submit a codebase they know, define what an AI agent should accomplish, and specify what result counts as success. The project then works with domain experts to pin dependencies, build the environment and evaluate the task. Current task forms include acceleration, discovery, repair, reproduction and integration.

The point of SciXXX is to bring real scientific software, domain judgement, task goals and verifiable feedback into one environment, as working infrastructure for AI agents, model training and discovery research.
SciXXX is open for task proposals now. Its English name is still to be confirmed [TBC]; details are on the project page.
